assignments.question: What is established by the external summary and what provenance and matched data are missing?

assignments.deliverable: Decision packet marking all four rows as hypothetical reported summaries, including one reported interval miss and missing denominators and provenance.
assignments.stop_condition: Screen as findings arrive; return separable gaps to existing Luna conversations; stop when decision-relevant uncertainty is explicit.

Screen source identity, timing meaning, overlap, comparability, raw support, contradictions and gaps; return separable issues to Luna
Retain full reported miss and all rows, including apparently favorable outcomes

expected_work_operations: Trace frequency sample versus reference sample, support age, recent presence, chunk boundaries and scheduling
Identify applicable estimator and configuration as unresolved until provenance is supplied

Design matched chunk-size comparison with same PCM and start, with differing scheduling recorded separately

assignments.question: Which protections cover payload, sample progress, endpoint and phase invalidation while investigating timing?

assignments.question: What alternative explanations and simple discriminators could account for the reported miss and mixed timings?

assignments.deliverable: Evidence-backed alternatives and focused controls, preserving dissent and assumptions.

assignments.stop_condition: Stop once distinct plausible alternatives and discriminating measurements are identified, or sources add no decision value.
assignments.model_reason: Distinct proactive investigation rather than confirmation.

Bound authoritative primary research to techniques that discriminate likely explanations

assignments.purpose: Make timely expert judgment without requiring scouts to finish.

assignments.stop_condition: Review when a slot opens, using available evidence; do not wait for all scouts if a strategic decision is ready.

Evaluate whether additional evidence requires redesign; maintain original full matrix and hold substantial dependent implementation until review

Ask whether declared range, levels and coherence reflect actual operation; preserve original requirements pending reply

assignments.question: What can be responsibly reported now and what would a complete feasibility decision require?
assignments.purpose: Communicate incomplete evidence and preserve decision objective.
assignments.deliverable: Interim: reported interval miss and mixed findings; no coverage rate, causal claim or acceptance conclusion. Future report retains all required metrics.
assignments.ownership: Read-only synthesis of authorized later evidence.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop at decision-ready synthesis or explicitly report incomplete evidence.
expected_work_operations: Request full counts, samples, error and interval results, nonpublications and work/memory
Only summarize acquisition median and p95 or coverage with an adequate complete dataset; distinguish sample time and processing time

concurrency: Terra coordinator plus up to four Luna scouts and one Sol expert fit the six-conversation cap. Use existing slots, run Sol as soon as useful without a screening barrier. L7 waits for scout-c; L5 and L6 reuse scout-b and scout-d as their prerequisites are met. Astra uses a freed slot if triggered; independent review reserves its own slot when an artifact exists. No evidence indicates any initial assignment actually ran. Hypothetical future processes remain capped at four with eight CPU cores and 16 GiB, shared writers serialized; study performs no campaign.
reuse: Retain prior assignment IDs and histories; E1 assignment is the pre-existing Sol owner, whereas source unit E1 is the new external report. Scout conversations are reused after completion; hand off concise evidence, uncertainty, alternatives and full provenance with direct access to sources. Original deadlines do not reset.

expert_and_human_triggers.sol: Continue timely measurement-contract review now; review any consequential redesign before dependent implementation and independently review any patch before acceptance.
expert_and_human_triggers.astra: Consult promptly on verified contradiction, strategic uncertainty, costly wrong turn or diminishing returns; summary alone does not establish a cause. No mandatory screen.
expert_and_human_triggers.human: Ask early about operational tolerances and representative coherence/range; obtain future execution authority if needed. Request report provenance through the authorized channel; silence grants nothing.
expert_and_human_triggers.repair: Retain original report and any later observed failures. One evidence-backed local worker repair only; consequential scope changes or exhausted repair go to Sol. Preserve all gates, phase, endpoint and payload contracts.

rejected_research: Inferring chunking causes the miss from four confounded rows, or treating the report as a run of our plan.
Calculating a population coverage rate, p95 or acceptance result from the incomplete summary.
Treating 0.10 Hz as a mandatory interval width when the proposed target concerns absolute error.
Algorithm changes, weakening gates, broad uncontrolled sweeps, or execution in this paper exercise.
assumptions_and_uncertainties: The reported +3 Hz row has 0.14 Hz error and 0.09 Hz uncertainty with truth uncovered; its actual provenance, implementation and timing semantics are unknown.

Offsets, noise/levels and chunk sizes vary together in the summary, so it cannot isolate chunk effects. Some intervals exceed 0.10 Hz, but the strict proposed target is error and separate coverage; no inference about precision acceptance follows from width alone.
No raw PCM, run commands, seeds, denominator, build identity, full table or independent verification are supplied. Preserve source/runtime distinctions and the dirty baseline.
